text: [curious] You do it [shouting] FIVE! [normal] times a day... but what does salah really mean?
You do it [shouting] FIVE! [curious] times a day... but what does salah really mean?
You hear it in every adhan:
Saad, laam, waw. It means: to pray.
A musalla: the place where you pray.
Your turn. The Prophet, peace be upon him, said: if you're invited to a meal and you're fasting, then do this:
Make DUA! For the one who invited you.
Because in Arabic, salah means dua: calling on Allah. Another narration says it plainly: meaning, dua. So every salah you pray is a dua.
Comment below: who's the first person you make dua for? And send this to them.
